# Instant-DB

**Understand your database instantly.**

Instant-DB is a fast, zero-install database workspace that lets developers and students **open, explore, query, edit, and understand SQLite databases directly in the browser**.

Instead of digging through tables or writing SQL for every simple question, users can ask questions in **plain English**. Its AI assistant understands the database schema, generates the appropriate SQL, safely executes read-only queries against the actual database, and presents the real results in an easy-to-understand way.

### ✨ Key Features

* 🗄️ **Open SQLite databases instantly** — no installation or complicated setup.
* 🤖 **AI Database Assistant** — ask questions about your data using natural language.
* ⚡ **Natural Language → SQL** — generate queries without manually writing SQL.
* 🔒 **Safe AI execution** — AI-generated read-only queries are validated before execution.
* 📊 **Powerful Data Grid** — browse, filter, sort, edit, duplicate, and delete records.
* 🔗 **Interactive ER Diagram** — automatically visualize relationships between tables.
* 🧠 **Schema-aware AI** — the assistant works with your actual database structure instead of guessing.
* 🛠️ **SQL Editor** — write, format, execute, and analyze SQL queries.
* 📥 **Import & Export** — work with CSV, JSON, and SQLite data.
* 🧪 **Fake Data Generator** — quickly generate realistic test data.
* ↩️ **Undo / Redo** — safely manage database changes.

name: Hisaab App
description:
Hisaab (حساب) digitises the committee — the rotating savings group (ROSCA / BC / بھشی) that tens of millions of Pakistani families already run every month.

One person creates a committee and adds members by name and phone — the members don't need the app yet. They immediately get a live ledger: who has paid, who hasn't, and whose turn it is to take the pot this month. A member marks "I have paid", the organizer confirms the cash arrived, and every action is written to an append-only audit trail that cannot be edited. Anyone still owing gets a one-tap WhatsApp reminder generated from the live ledger, so it can never name someone who has already paid.

Because every on-time payment is now recorded and independently confirmed, the app produces something that never existed before: the Hisaab Score — a portable repayment history the member owns and a lender can actually check. When a member later installs the app and registers with the same number, their entire history is already waiting for them.

Built in Flutter (Android + web) on Supabase Postgres, with every authorisation rule enforced inside the database rather than the app. Fully bilingual Urdu and English, Urdu by default.

Negotia – Chrome Extension for Smarter Negotiation
Negotia is a Chrome extension designed to help users handle negotiations more confidently and efficiently. It is built for situations where a person receives a client message, contract proposal, salary offer, or scope request and needs to quickly understand the position, estimate value, and respond strategically.

Why this extension exists
Many people struggle with negotiation because they:

do not know whether an offer is competitive
cannot quickly assess leverage
do not know how to respond professionally
lose time trying to interpret vague client messages
fear accepting a low-value deal or making a weak counteroffer
This extension solves that problem by turning a raw message into a structured negotiation assessment in seconds.

What the extension does
When the user pastes a negotiation message into the extension, it:

detects the type of negotiation
extracts key details like amount, stage, and tone
estimates a market value
identifies the user’s leverage level
calculates a suggested counteroffer
generates a negotiation strategy
drafts a response message that can be copied and used immediately
This makes the extension useful for:

freelancers negotiating project rates
job seekers discussing salary or compensation
teams reviewing client proposals
professionals handling contract terms and scope changes

name: Bijli Bill Check
description:
Bijli Bill Check opens the black box of a Pakistani electricity bill. It
recomputes every line from NEPRA's residential tariff — slabs, fuel adjustment,
electricity duty, GST, PTV fee, income tax — then does what no other bill app
does: it works backwards from the amount you were actually charged and names the
single change that reproduces it, to the rupee. "Your bill is only consistent
with 320 units, not the 301 printed on it."

It also finds the cliff: above 300 units the slab benefit is withdrawn and every
unit is repriced, so one extra unit can cost Rs 3,579. It reconciles the two
meter readings printed on your bill, detects estimated readings, tells you
whether you should be on a Time-of-Use meter, and ends by generating an editable
complaint and opening the real filing channels — the CCMS+ portal every DISCO
runs, SMS 8118, your company's own WhatsApp line — then NEPRA and the Wafaqi
Mohtasib.

Works fully offline as an installable PWA, in English and Urdu, with no accounts
and no data leaving your device. Zero dependencies, zero build step. 133 unit
tests and 18 browser tests.

So people miss due dates, pay late fees, or sign papers they don't fully understand. Faham fixes that.

You paste any document, pick a mode, and Faham explains it in simple Urdu, gives a Roman-Urdu version, and separates out the facts that actually matter: the amount, the deadline, the penalty, and what you must do next. It needs no login, works on a phone, and takes seconds.

The app has four modes:

Document — explains a bill, bank or legal notice in plain Urdu, with key facts as cards
Translate — English to Urdu
Roman-Urdu to Nastaliq — turns text as people type it on phones into proper Urdu script
Summarize — shortens long content into simple Urdu
It's built as a lightweight web app (Node.js + Gemini's free tier), mobile-first, and deployed live so anyone can use it immediately — including elderly parents who ask their kids to read every bill for them.

name: Rahnuma
description:
Pakistan runs on paper that ordinary people cannot read. Bills, challans, lab reports, prescriptions and government notices decide what a family pays, takes and owes — and almost none of them are written to be understood. The cost is real: money paid that was never owed, medicine taken wrongly, deadlines missed, and complaints never filed because nobody knows the words.

Rahnuma — "guide" — is six tools for that gap:

• Samajh — photograph any bill, challan, notice or form; get what it says, what you owe, and by when
• Report — lab results explained in plain Urdu, never diagnosed
• Nuskha — reads the doctor's handwriting, and says "unclear, ask your pharmacist" rather than guessing
• Dawa Sahi — what a medicine is for, how it's taken, and whether the pharmacy charged above the price printed on the box
• Shikayat — interviews you by voice, then writes a formal application addressed to the correct authority, downloadable as PDF or Word. It replaces the arzi nawees who sits outside every government office charging Rs 200 to word a complaint properly
• Bijli Bachao — Pakistan's 200-unit protected-slab cliff, shown before the bill arrives instead of after

Every answer comes back in English, Urdu and Roman Urdu from a single request, and is read aloud automatically in a natural voice. You can speak instead of typing.

Built with Next.js and Gemini for Pakistan @79, GDG Live Pakistan — Chai aur Code #1.

name: NightCode3
description:
# NightCode

**NightCode** is an open-source, full-stack AI coding assistant designed to give developers an agentic coding environment that can understand, modify, test, and interact with real codebases. It runs locally, supports multiple AI providers, and provides an extensible tool and MCP architecture for giving AI agents real capabilities.

## ✨ Key Features

* 🤖 **Agentic AI Coding** — An AI agent capable of reasoning through coding tasks and working directly with your project.
* 🔌 **Multi-Provider AI** — Supports **14 AI providers**, including OpenAI, Google Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, xAI, Ollama, Cloudflare, and more.
* 🔄 **Automatic Provider Failover** — Health monitoring, rate-limit tracking, and provider/key rotation help keep the agent running when a provider becomes unavailable.
* 🛠️ **22 Built-in Tools** — File reading, writing, editing, deletion, directory management, code search, grep, shell execution, testing, task tracking, delegation, artifacts, image generation, and more.
* 🧠 **Smart Context Management** — Automatic context compaction, token tracking, and sliding-window decisions help prevent context overflow while preserving important information.
* 🔗 **MCP Support** — Extend the agent with custom **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** servers for databases, APIs, browser automation, and other external capabilities.
* 🧩 **Skills System** — Add specialized instructions and capabilities through reusable skills that can be enabled globally or activated per message.
* 🎨 **Rich Artifacts** — Render and interact with code, Markdown, HTML, SVG, Mermaid diagrams, and mathematical expressions directly inside the interface.
* 🖼️ **AI Image Generation** — Generate images through supported AI models directly from the agent.
* 👥 **Sub-Agent Delegation** — Delegate specialized tasks to other agents for more complex workflows.
* 🧪 **Testing & Error Detection** — Built-in tools for running tests and retrieving project/build errors.
* 📋 **Task & Plan Management** — Supports structured task tracking and plan completion for longer coding workflows.
* 💾 **Agent Memory** — Retrieve stored memories to provide better context across interactions.
* ⚡ **Event-Driven Engine** — A modern engine architecture for streaming responses, tool dispatch, verification, context management, caching, and telemetry.
* 🖥️ **Local-First Development** — Designed to run locally while allowing developers to bring their own AI provider API keys.
* 🎛️ **Customizable Workspace** — Configure AI providers, models, temperature, token limits, themes, and other settings from the application.

## 🏗️ Architecture

NightCode uses an event-driven agent architecture:

**User → Agent Engine → AI Provider → Tool Dispatch → Tool Execution → Verification → Context Manager → Agent**

This allows the agent to continuously reason, use tools, inspect their results, and continue working until the requested task is completed.

## 🧰 Tech Stack

* **Next.js**
* **React**
* **TypeScript**
* **Tailwind CSS**
* **shadcn/ui**
* **AI SDK / Multi-provider AI**
* **MCP (Model Context Protocol)**
* **SQLite**
* **Event-driven agent engine**

NightCode is built to be more than a simple AI chatbot — it is an extensible **AI development environment** where models can actually interact with code, tools, files, tests, external services, and developer workflows.

name: Rag-e-jan
description:
Rag-e-Jaan is a real-time platform where anyone can post an urgent blood request in seconds — blood group, hospital, city, urgency level, and a contact number — and it instantly appears on a live, filterable board that potential donors can search by blood group and city. No accounts, no friction, no scrolling through irrelevant posts. Just a direct line between someone who needs blood and someone nearby who can give it.

How It Works
Post an SOS — Fill a simple form with blood group, hospital/city, urgency, and contact info.
Live board — The request appears instantly, color-coded by urgency (critical / within 24hrs / within days).
Filter & find — Donors filter by their blood group and city to see only relevant, nearby requests.
Direct response — One tap to call — no messaging system, no delay.
Mark as fulfilled — Requesters close out their post once help arrives, keeping the board clean and current.
Why It Matters

Blood donation in Pakistan doesn't suffer from a lack of willing donors — it suffers from a matching problem: the right donor almost never sees the right request at the right time. Rag-e-Jaan solves that gap directly, with zero cost, zero login barrier, and a design built for genuine urgency — because when it comes to blood, every minute counts

name: Kaaghaz-Saathi
description:
Kaghaz Saathi AI is a multilingual government-document preparation assistant built for Pakistani citizens. It helps users understand what documents and preparation steps may be required before visiting an office for services such as domicile, CNIC renewal, passport applications, learner driving licences, and scholarships.
Users can ask questions in English, Urdu, or Roman Urdu. The platform provides service-specific checklists, city-aware guidance, next steps, common mistakes, and a readiness score showing how prepared the user is. Users can select the documents they already have, share their readiness status through WhatsApp, and print a checklist before visiting an office.

It does not replace official government departments or guarantee application approval. name: Waris

name: Roz Ka Hisab
description:
Har ghar ki kahani same hai.

Ammi subah doodh lene jati hain, pata chalta hai kal se 20 rupay mehenga. Bazaar se daal, masalay, atta lete hain, har dukan ka apna rate. Aur mahine ke end pe jab KE ka bill aata hai - Rs. 60,000 - samajh hi nahi aata itna bill bana kaise?

79 saal ho gaye Pakistan ko, lekin roz ka hisab abhi tak barabar nahi hua.

Roz Ka Hisab is for that exact moment.

It's not another price list app. It's your daily expense protector, built for how Pakistanis actually live.

What it does:

1. Sahi Daam - سہی دام
Your daily kiryana finally has one true price. Check official DC rates for the things you actually buy daily - Doodh, Daal Moong/Masoor, Masalay, Atta, Cheeni, Chawal, Oil. See Official Rate vs Market Rate in simple Urdu, Roman Urdu, or English. Scan a dukan's rate board with your camera, or just say "daal ka rate kya hai?" No more arguing. If one shop refuses, the app shows you 3 nearby shops that are verified fair by your own neighbors.

2. Sahi Bill - سہی بل
That 60,000 bill finally makes sense. Upload your electricity or gas bill, and Roz Ka Hisab translates it into simple Urdu. No jargon. Just - "Aapne 320 units use kiye, 200 ke baad mehenga slab lagta hai, is liye bill zyada hai. AC 1 ghanta kam chalao to agle mahine Rs. 1,800 bachega."

name: AzadiPath
description:
AzadiPath is an AI agent that builds a single life roadmap for young Pakistanis instead of separate, disconnected advice. Most students in Pakistan get scattered guidance. 

- A teacher tells them what to study. 
- A relative tells them where to invest. 
- A Youube video tells them how to apply abroad. 
  None of these connect. 

AzadiPath merges career planning, education pathways, and financial growth into one system that shows a user what their next twenty years could look like based on choices they make today.

The agent takes basic inputs like age, target field, and monthly savings capacity, then generates a path that links three things together. 

First, an education and career route, for example which degree, which local internship, which scholarship, and which company to target. 

Second, a financial growth model, showing how a small monthly investment in the local stock market compounds over the years. 

Third, a timeline that shows how starting five years earlier changes the outcome dramatically.

name: FunVerse

FunVerse is a playground of tiny AI-powered tools that make the internet fun again. Built with Google Gemini and Next.js, and deployed on Vercel.

name: Focus Garden
description: Focus Garden is a calm, Pomodoro-style focus timer that turns concentration into something visual and alive. Instead of watching a plain countdown, you set an intention, choose a plant species, and start a session - a hand-illustrated SVG plant grows in real time as you stay focused, blooming into full flower if you finish and wilting if you give up or drift away. It tracks streaks, focus history, and a GitHub-style 30-day activity heatmap, and runs entirely client-side: no accounts, no backend, no tracking - every session is stored locally in your browser, with one-click export/import for backups. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, and Tailwind CSS, with all plant growth animated through Framer Motion and every ambient sound (rain, forest, waves, bloom chimes) synthesized live via the Web Audio API instead of shipped as audio files. Supports light, dark, and auto themes, and installs as a PWA.

name: Golfly
description: Golfly is the all-in-one player companion and course management platform that finally solves the everyday frustrations golfers face: finding reliable partners, managing gear, entering tournaments, and tracking real progress. Instead of scrambling through WhatsApp groups and scattered apps, players can instantly pair up for matches based on handicap, location, and availability, then coordinate tee times and chat in one place. The built-in marketplace makes buying and selling clubs, bags, balls, and tees effortless, turning unused gear into value while keeping transactions local and trusted. Tournaments Finder aggregates nearby events and leagues with clear formats, fees, and one-tap registration, so going from discovery to sign-up takes seconds. The handicap calculator follows standard rules and updates automatically as rounds are logged, giving every player an accurate, credible index. Course Caddie delivers smart yardages, club suggestions, and playing-condition insights tailored to each course and day, acting like a caddie in your pocket. Swings & Drills adds structured practice with short, focused routines and simple progress tracking so improvement feels real and rewarding. The UI is clean, fast, and built for the range and the course—big buttons, clear flows, and minimal taps to what matters. Behind the scenes, Golfly runs on a production-ready stack with secure auth, scalable APIs, and CI/CD, making it genuinely ready to ship, not just a prototype

name: HexGuard
description: HexGuard is a browser-native digital forensics utility that inspects files at the binary level. By dissecting magic bytes from the file header, HexGuard identifies the true binary format, flags dangerous extension mismatches (such as executables disguised as images), renders an interactive 64-byte hex dump, and calculates SHA-256 hashes—with zero data ever leaving the user's browser.

name: FUNBOX
description:
FUNBOX is one page with six hand-made toys, built for the theme "make internet fun". No signup, no account, no tracking, no backend, no database, no environment variables. It is a static Next.js page that deploys with an empty environment, and it keeps working offline after the first load.

The toys. Every Website: a fake article that drowns in its own consent banners, newsletter modals and countdown offers, and then cleans itself up to reveal the same page with nothing on it. Not A Robot: a captcha with real deterministic logic and absurd prompts, plus a slider that snaps back. Cursor Chaos: a 1998 sparkle trail, a marquee you can stop, and a button that runs away. Guestbook: entries stay in your browser, seeded with 1998 era posts, and the page says so plainly. Dial-Up Karaoke: dial the ISP number yourself and hear a synthesised handshake you can sing along to. Slop Machine: paste a sentence, get it back in LinkedIn bait, SEO blog and engagement farm dialects, with a live slop score.

The point: the internet stopped being fun because every page became a funnel. Fun is cheap. Six toys, one URL, zero data collected. The one thing we did not joke about is accessibility: every tile and toy is keyboard operable, contrast was measured with a script rather than eyeballed, and reduced motion is respected. Built in two hours, from theme reveal to live URL, by a team of five AI agents coordinating only through files in a shared folde

name: Forensic Integrity Verifier

name: Dear Hoever
description:
Mail It Forward is a tiny art exchange that makes the internet feel
hand-delivered again. You draw a postcard on a 32×32 pixel canvas —
small enough that anyone can make art, big enough to say something —
write a note to a stranger, pick a stamp, and mail it. Somewhere in
the world, someone receives your one-of-one original and mails one of
their own forward. No feeds, no likes, no algorithms: just a mailbox
full of tiny kindnesses from people you'll never meet. Built for the
"Make the Internet Fun" theme, because the best part of the internet
was always finding something a human made just for you.

name: Funternet
description:
Funternet Arcade Project Description

Funternet Arcade is an AI-powered web experience that transforms boring internet content into fun, interactive games.

Users can paste an article, study notes, technical concepts, Terms & Conditions, or simply enter a topic they want to explore. Using Google Gemini, Funternet analyzes the content and dynamically converts it into a personalized game experience such as a Boss Battle, Trivia Rush, Escape Room, Mystery Quest, Speed Challenge, or interactive adventure.

Instead of passively reading information, users actively play through it—earning XP, building streaks, answering challenges, defeating AI-generated bosses, unlocking achievements, and celebrating victories with animations and confetti.

For example, boring Terms & Conditions can become a battle against “The Terms & Conditions Demon,” while learning DNS can become “Escape the DNS Dungeon.”

The project directly reflects the hackathon theme “Make Internet Fun” by reimagining the internet as something users can play, not just consume.

Key Features
AI-generated games powered by Google Gemini
Multiple interactive game modes
Dynamic stories, questions, challenges, and boss battles
XP, streaks, scoring, achievements, and progress tracking
Animated boss health and game feedback
Fun loading experiences and micro-interactions
Shareable final scores
Recently played games stored locally
Built-in demo games for reliable offline/live presentations
Fully responsive mobile and desktop experience
Tech Stack

Next.js · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Framer Motion · Google Gemini API · Vercel

One-line pitch

Funternet Arcade turns anything boring on the internet into an AI-powered game.

Short submission version

Funternet Arcade is an AI-powered platform that transforms boring internet content into interactive games. Paste an article, notes, Terms & Conditions, or any topic, and Gemini turns it into boss battles, quizzes, escape rooms, and challenges with XP, streaks, achievements, and animated gameplay. Instead of simply consuming the internet, Funternet lets you play it.

Sorry for this big Summary I was short on time couldn't compact this :)

Object Royale

**Photograph your room. Turn everyday objects into fighters. Make them battle.**

Object Royale is a mobile-first AI fighting game that transforms any photo of your surroundings into a playable roster. Photograph your desk, and objects such as your chai cup, laptop, stapler and headphones come alive as unique fighters—each with its own name, personality, type, statistics, weaknesses, moves and passive abilities.

Players choose a fighter, customize its loadout and enter a strategic turn-based battle against the CPU. Moves can inflict damage or status effects including burn, stun, shield, boost and weaken. Powerful attacks consume more energy, so every turn requires a meaningful decision.

Gemini 2.5 Flash analyzes the uploaded image, identifies four to six objects and returns their locations as structured data. Each detected object is cropped from the original photograph to create its fighter portrait. AI then designs object-specific abilities: a hot drink can burn opponents, a phone can stun them with a notification barrage, a bottle can heal and a book can create a defensive shield.

During battle, an AI announcer reacts to every attack with dynamic commentary, which can also be spoken aloud. Synthesized arcade sounds, animations and phone vibration make each hit feel impactful. After the fight, Object Royale generates a boxing-style victory poster containing the fighters, final result and a “tale of the tape” statistics table that users can save or share directly from their device.

The interface uses a distinctive fight-night poster and risograph-zine aesthetic, featuring warm paper textures, thick ink outlines, halftone patterns, offset shadows and bold condensed typography. It includes dedicated responsive layouts for both mobile and desktop.

Object Royale was built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4 and Motion. It uses Gemini 2.5 Flash through OpenRouter for vision and structured fighter generation, Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite for commentary, and a custom TypeScript battle engine tested through more than 2,000 simulated fights. Web Audio, Web Speech, Web Share and image-generation browser APIs provide sound, spoken commentary and shareable posters.

The application is designed to remain reliable during live demonstrations. If the AI service or internet connection fails, a built-in demo arena remains completely playable and commentary automatically switches to prepared fallback lines. Repeated image scans are cached, AI output is limited to control costs, API keys remain server-side and people or personal information are excluded from image analysis.

Object Royale was developed through AI-agent orchestration. A planning agent produced the specifications, visual language and shared type contracts, while specialized coding agents developed the battle engine, AI pipeline and application screens in parallel. Their work was reviewed and integrated before deployment.

**Repository:** https://github.com/hamzajavid-dev/Object-Royale

name: Flood Command
description:
FloodCommand is an autonomous, agentic disaster-response system built to solve a specific failure in Pakistan's flood relief efforts: the human bottleneck. Every existing system relies on a single coordinator reading WhatsApp messages, judging severity, and manually calling NGOs — a process that collapses under the volume of a real flood, contributing to the ~72-hour average delay before rescue reaches victims (a gap tied to 1,739 deaths and 33 million displaced in the 2022 Pakistan floods alone).

FloodCommand replaces that human chokepoint with a pipeline of five specialized AI agents communicating over a Redis event bus: **Intake** parses distress messages in Urdu/Pashto, **Triage** scores severity (weighing injuries, children, rising water), **Geo** resolves described locations to GPS coordinates via Nominatim, **Dispatch** matches the nearest available NGO using Haversine distance and locks the assignment to prevent duplication, and **Notify** simultaneously messages both the victim and the responding NGO via WhatsApp — no human approval required.

Built on FastAPI, the Claude API, Redis, Twilio, and Leaflet.js for live map visualization, and deployable on Railway, the system is designed to turn a 72-hour coordination delay into roughly 90 seconds — using WhatsApp, an interface already familiar to 128 million Pakistani users. It's a hackathon-stage prototype demonstrating real-time, multi-agent disaster coordination.

name: TrackMe Tarot
description: TrackMe Tarot is a zero-login web app that shows people how much the internet already knows about them, in the funniest way possible. In about 10 seconds it reads what every website can silently see (device, timezone, fonts, battery, connection) and uses the Gemini API to turn those signals into a witty, eerily accurate tarot-style fortune like "The 1AM Overthinker", along with a 0-100 Exposure Score, three practical tips to reduce your digital footprint, and a shareable card built for WhatsApp, LinkedIn and X. It makes privacy awareness fun instead of boring, and nothing is stored: signals are read locally and only a short summary is used to write the fortune, with a rule-based fallback so it never breaks. As a startup, the free viral tool builds the audience, while "TrackMe for Teams" lets companies, banks and universities send branded campaign links and track team exposure on a dashboard, targeting the multi-billion-dollar security awareness market that people currently find dull. Built with Vite, vanilla JS, Vercel serverless functions and the Gemini API using Antigravity IDE.

name: PurrfectCare - AI Feline Health & Adoption Platform
description:
PurrfectCare is a full-stack, AI-powered pet care and feline health platform. Built during the vibe coding session, it features:

AI Health Triage: An automated symptom assessment engine with deterministic safety rules and severity classification (Low, Medium, Emergency).

Smart Nutrition Calculator: Caloric and macro meal planning with a toxic food ingredient alert system.

Cat Adoption Matching: Vector-based profile recommendations matching rescue cats to adopters based on environment and lifestyle.

Wellness Dashboard: Preventive vaccination schedules and weight tracking.
Built using Next.js 14 (App Router), Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Supabase (PostgreSQL), and Gemini API.

name: StudyFlow
description: StudyFlow is a student productivity web application designed to bring everyday academic tasks into one connected workspace. Students can manage their timetable, assignments, exams, attendance, study sessions, goals, and progress without switching between multiple tools.

name: Your Story to Fun Stckers Conversion
description:
Sticker Story Teller is an AI-powered web app that turns everyday moments into fun, visual stories using emojis and stickers. You simply describe what happened, choose a vibe, and the app transforms your story into a mini animated comic that you can remix, make even more chaotic, and share as an image.

The idea is simple: turn ordinary internet moments into something creative, funny, and shareable.

name: Boomup Core CS
description: Boomup Core CS is a fast-paced, interactive learning platform designed for CS, Software Engineering, Data Science, and IT students that transforms complex, abstract technical theories into hyper-addictive, 30-second arcade-style micro-games. Inspired by the rapid-fire, low-stakes design pattern of Waste My Brain, the application replaces dry textbook definitions with tactile visual mechanics—such as sliders and tap-to-lock buttons—enabling users to directly manipulate real-time system behaviors like Big-O memory scaling, Gradient Descent optimization loops, and multi-threaded Mutex concurrency controls. By delivering instant visual feedback—where unoptimized logic choices visibly trigger crashing servers, exploding gradients, or data corruption—the app removes the steep intimidation barrier of advanced computing math and engineering systems, allowing beginners and elite students alike to build sharp, fluid architectural intuition in short, incremental doses.
